description: Streaming and non-streaming paths produce identical digest for the same generation. The SSE reassembly of the text-basic stream and the equivalent non-streaming response object must yield the same digest. This is the invariant that makes response_digest meaningful for streaming clients: the capsule commits to a value a non-streaming client could independently reproduce.
note: If invariant_holds is False, there is a bug in either the SSE reassembly function or the test fixture construction. A correct generator always produces True here.
